eye.method: 256-symbol periodic pattern, 16 samples/UI; best raw vertical gap over 16 phases and ±8 UI delay; no equalizer/noise/CDR

conventions.electricalS: two-port, both reference impedances 50 ohm; independent of actual RT
conventions.loadedReflection: input reflection at 50 ohm reference with actual RT
conventions.rc: lumped series junction pair for total active length; not electrode S11
conventions.eo: mean junction voltage in optical frame / its 0.001 GHz value; not electrical S21
conventions.transfer: static equal-arm linear phase model; electrode differential voltage, fixed optical loss
conventions.pnBias: live geometry: C/R from existing depletion model; local optical slope from ±0.01 V finite difference (one-sided at 0/3 V); loss at bias. Fixed card mode has no bias dependence
conventions.eye: source waveform → 2nd-order Butterworth driver → loaded CPW / junction RC → cosine optical transfer. Linearized PN at bias, constant loss, no large-signal carrier dynamics. Model truncated above 240 GHz; equal series junctions see ±Vdiff/2. Positive gap is not a compliance pass
conventions.source: open-circuit Vpp; source resistance separate from 50 ohm S-parameter reference
